node.statement: Corollary A.1 (Mix+(GPS) as conditional PGM): Mix+(GPS) first performs weak Schur sampling to obtain lambda, then conditioned on lambda, implements the PGM over the rank-ell(lambda) Hilbert-Schmidt measure mu_HS^{d,ell(lambda)}. This follows from Proposition A.1 applied to the conditional purification channel Phi^{d,ell(lambda)}.
